unknowns: SPM evidence of tax compliance must be available/acceptable
SPM must evidence appropriate insurance cover
Operational plan for onsite advisory in Ireland
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strong native SPM scope: creative direction, animation/AR assets, WebAR/app deployment, QR integration, mobile optimisation, testing and rollout. DCE shows no turnover, reference, certification or staffing threshold. Not FINAL_SUPER_GREEN because bidder-specific tax/insurance evidence remains unverified.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Provision of a Single Party Framework for the ongoing support, maintenance, and development of YourSpace Portals, associated websites, associated systems and associated services.
unknowns: Whether SPM alone meets EUR 100k turnover in each of the last three financial years
Whether SPM/partners can evidence three comparable contracts at the required scale
Whether required insurance levels or broker confirmations can be arranged
Whether two EU/EEA hosting facilities and required resources can be demonstrated
confirmed_supergreens.why: Excellent digital scope but the qualification burden is material. Viable as partner/consortium/reliance route if turnover, three comparable references, hosting and insurance gates can be covered; not a solo supergreen on current evidence.

confirmed_supergreens.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung Websites

unknowns: Whether SPM/partners have three sufficiently strong Magnolia CMS references
Whether required ISMS/security capability and operational staffing can be demonstrated
Whether insurance requirements can be met
confirmed_supergreens.why: Strategically relevant web work but operationally enterprise-heavy and reference-driven. Three detailed Magnolia references determine selection into the top five; substantial cloud/security/operations burden makes this partner-heavy rather than lean-direct.

Because the San Joaquin Valley is crucial for the western monarch butterfly during migration the maintenance and restoration of habitat that occurs within public lands in this area is essential to prevent further decline and further need for conservation. The San Joaquin Valley contains vital habitats rich in milkweed and a variety of other nectar plants, which are critical for monarch breeding and migration. Understanding of how butterflies and other pollinators use National Wildlife Refuges (NWRs) in the area is needed to determine the role that public lands can play in reducing butterfly decline. Enhancing nectar availability is a key strategy for pollinator conservation and will benefit not just the western monarch but also other pollinator species. Restoring and improving nectar availability in native habitats can help support a variety of pollinator species. To prioritize management actions and improve conservation outcomes, it is necessary to assess the quantity and quality of existing habitats and understand how they are used by monarchs and other pollinators. Question: Can you provide more information on the existing drain system(s) at the facility? This drain will be on the back side of the units. 3. Biologically, two 12"x18" trout- style boxes cannot safely support 75,000 Coho salmon eggs to the fry stage. HE will meet the following US Navy Divers Compressed Helium Breathing Purity Requirements (Military Specification MIL-PRF- 27407): - Helium (percent by volume) 99.997% - Moisture (water vapor) 9 ppm (max) - Dew Point (not greater than) -78F - Hydrocarbons (as Methane) 1 ppm (max) - Oxygen 3 ppm (max) - Nitrogen + Argon 5 ppm (max) - Neon 23 ppm (max) - Hydrogen 1 ppm (max) 2.2 Carbon Dioxide (CO2) The vendor will provide two (2) onsite CO2 storage micro-bulk storage tanks; one supporting a 300,000-gallon pool (PERMA CYL 1000) and one supporting a 1,000,000-gallon pool (PERMA CYL 2000). This rental will include general maintenance, urgent repairs, and notification of tank levels and warnings via the Telemetry Unit. The Telemetry unit is a proprietary unit that will monitor the levels of the CO2 and communicate directly with the vendor when the levels become low. The vendor will provide CO2 as required. ith manufacturing and approving a new coupling design, as opposed to simply replacing the pads, significantly increases the risk of the current pads failing in service. Such a failure would render the LSV2 unavailable to support critical Navy research and development programs. d. Increased Program Risk: Replacing the entire coupling introduces significant technical risks of mission failure. The new design could adversely affect LSV2's acoustic signature, a critical performance characteristic. The current system has a known and accepted acoustic performance, whereas a new system would require extensive and costly validation to ensure it meets requirements. Therefore, based on the market survey conducted, and all else being considered, it has been determined that only the Philadelphia Gear brand coupling pads can requirement in time to meet scheduled acoustic trials. 6. forms_signatures.text: ndor other than Philadelphia Gear would necessitate a complete redesign and replacement of the entire coupling system rather than just the pads. This course of action is not feasible for the following reasons: a. NAVSEA Drawing Approval: The LSV2 shafting system is documented on an approved NAVSEA drawing. Any modification to this design requires formal NAVSEA approval, a process that can exceed two years, introducing significant delays to the program. b. Increased Costs: A complete coupling redesign and build would result in a substantial increase in cost for the Government compared to the cost of procuring only the replacement pads. c. Schedule and Operational Delays: The schedule delay associated with manufacturing and approving a new coupling design, as opposed to simply replacing the pads, significantly increases the risk of the current pads failing in service. Such a failure would render the LSV2 unavailable to support critical Navy research and development programs. d. Increased Program Risk: Replacing the entire coupling introduces significant technical risks of mission failure. The new design could adversely affect LSV2's acoustic signature, a critical performance characteristic. The current system has a known and accepted acoustic performance, whereas a new system would require extensive and costly validation to ensure it meets requirements. Therefore, based on the market survey conducted, and all else being considered, it has been determined that only the Philadelphia Gear brand coupling pads can requirement in time to meet scheduled acoustic trials. 6. Scope The contractor shall manufacture, furnish, and deliver six-cubic-yard counterbalanced-lid solid waste containers to MCMWTC. Hankelepingu täitmisel, sh võimalike vigade kõrvaldamisel tekkivate täitja ja tellija vaheliste erimeelsuste lahendamisel lähtutakse eelkõige tööde teostamise eesmärkidest tellija seisukohalt. Kui täitja ei nõustu tellija seisukohaga, lasub tellija seisukoha mittesobivuse tõendamise kohustus täitjal. Täitja vastutab tööde teostamise käigus tellijale või kolmandatele isikutele tekitatud kahju eest kogu kahju ulatuses. Täitja vastutab igasuguse hankelepingu rikkumise eest, eelkõige kui täitja ei ole hankelepingut täitnud või kui tööd ei vasta lepingus sätestatud nõuetele vms. 1. Objectives of the Assignment

The primary objective of this assignment is to support the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning in achieving sustainable revenue growth by ensuring the formulation and implementation of effective, data-driven tax policies. The Resident Consultant for Tax Policy Division will provide strategic advisory services and technical expertise to improve the government’s revenue mobilization, fiscal sustainability, and the overall effectiveness of tax policies.

2. Scope of Work

The Resident Consultant for Tax Policy Division will undertake the following key tasks:

  1. Capacity building
    1. Support the ministry develop fit for purpose learning and development needs for the tax and revenue policy teams;
    2. Support the ministry on developing a learning and development strategy/plan to respond to the needs identified above.
    3. Support government implement the learning and development strategy.
